user.title: SmartThings Token Setup
user.description:
Enter your SmartThings Personal Access Token to connect to your Samsung Air Conditioner.

To get a token:
1. Go to {setup_url}
2. Click 'Generate new token'
3. Give it a name like 'Home Assistant'
4. Select the required permissions
5. Copy the token and paste it below

init.title: Smarter Samsung AC LED Options
init.description:
Configure how often Home Assistant checks the AC LED status. Lower values provide faster updates but may use more API requests.

Recommended: 30 seconds for normal use, 10-15 seconds for frequent control.
